description: Thread text between area or path type frames (Type > Threaded Text): link flows text through the frames in the order given; release takes the frames out of their threads, keeping the rest linked (Release Selection); remove breaks every thread through them, leaving the text in place (Remove Threading)

separateParagraphs.description: link: end each frame's text with a paragraph return before the next frame's text joins it

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true. For link, give ids in reading order

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: thread_text_frames
title: Thread Text Frames
